answer: A collateral garden where each identity deposits stake into time-locked vaults. Every participant must solve a sequential verifiable delay function (VDF) verified against a shared crystal beacon before qualifying for routing. A malicious cluster cannot parallelize the VDF computation and must lock capital per fake identity under an unbending willow policy where slashed deposits are permanently burned. Attacker cost scales strictly linearly in non-amortizable time and capital, making swarm creation negative expected value.
